_comment_composite: Every workspace is a composite project so `tsc -b` can skip the ones whose inputs have not changed. Without it each of build / typecheck / dev recompiled all twelve packages from cold (~6.5 min a run, paid three or four times a session). The cross-package `references` in each tsconfig are derived from that package's @atlas/* dependencies and verified by scripts/build-packages.mjs — never hand-maintained. Build outputs (dist/ + *.tsbuildinfo) are dockerignored, so image builds stay cold and honest.
